ad_library.summary: Truzon Solar has been advertising on Meta continuously since May 2026 - the longest-running programme in this Hyderabad set - with 3 live ads across 2 creatives (7 ads share one creative, 6 share another). Every creative is Hindi or Marathi, and every CTA drops the click into a Facebook lead form.

funnel.meaning: The click never reaches truzonsolar.com. You cannot retarget the people who clicked and did not call, you cannot test a landing page, and the phone number in the button is the only thing connecting the ad to your business.

findings: Every live creative is Hindi or Marathi. In Hyderabad the strongest solar ads run in Telugu to the same homeowners - your own head office is here, but your ads are not speaking the local language.
7 ads share one creative and 6 share another. You are buying reach on two ideas while competitors test new angles weekly.

The 'Call Now' button sends people into a Facebook lead form, not your own quote page - so none of your residential, commercial, industrial and ground-mounted service pages ever get seen by paid traffic.
You have the longest-running ad programme in this market (since May 2026) - which means the tracking and retargeting gap has been costing you the whole time.
next_steps: Translate the winning 'solar is no longer difficult' message into Telugu and test it against the Hindi and Marathi versions. This is the cheapest lift available in this market.
Send the click to your own page
Move the CTA from the Facebook form to a Hyderabad landing page with a quote form, so the traffic becomes an asset you own and can retarget.
Test 3-4 new angles - subsidy math, EMI vs bill, Dussehra-style offer, commercial rooftop - instead of spending the whole budget on two creatives.
Put call tracking on the 9030032222 button so you know which creative actually produces booked site visits.
